title: "Simulation & Observation"
description: "Run a model on a network, measure it the way an experiment would, and explore parameters."

With a model and a network in hand, this topic covers running the simulation, deciding
what to *measure* from it (BOLD, EEG, functional connectivity), and sweeping parameters
to see how behaviour changes.

## Learn

- [Simulation experiments](SimulationExperiments.qmd) — assemble dynamics, network and
  integrator, run on a backend, and inspect the result.

## Do

- [Parameter exploration](ParameterExploration.qmd) *(draft)* — grid sweeps and parallel
  execution.
- [Visualization](Visualization.qmd) *(draft)* — plot time series, networks, and matrices.
